8	# Python — review checklists
9	
10	Consumed by the `/kk:review-code` skill. When the `python` profile is active, every checklist in **Always load** is applied to the diff. There are no conditional entries for this profile.
11	
12	## Always load
13	
14	- [security-checklist.md](security-checklist.md) — Python-specific security smells: input validation, deserialization, subprocess/shell injection, crypto misuse, secret handling.
15	- [solid-checklist.md](solid-checklist.md) — SOLID design-principle smells expressed in Python: module cohesion, protocol segregation, dependency inversion, duck-typing boundaries.
16	- [code-quality-checklist.md](code-quality-checklist.md) — idiomatic Python quality signals: typing, mutability, context managers, exception hygiene, maintainability.
17	- [removal-plan.md](removal-plan.md) — staged-removal template for Python code being retired (modules, packages, public APIs).
